description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called HomeToolbar, along with its nested views, for creating a toolbar interface in an iOS application. It includes buttons to display connection status, chat, talk, and settings actions, customizing appearance based on environment modes and external states.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Updates the pulsing animation of the status indicator based on the gateway state, scene phase, and motion reduction environment.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Computes the accessibility label describing the current status for assistive technologies.
